regime_context: The Big Banks theme leads the momentum rank but is crowded and shows a mixed trend. The absolute trend gate is active and has historically reduced drawdowns. Rotation is broad but not directional, with no confirmed handoff. Macro narrative is dominated by AI/geopolitics headlines, providing coincident backdrop.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utility & Renewables is eligible for trend-following, has solid breadth (0.846) and is not crowded. The trend-gate, the only validated risk-control leg, suggests staying-power absent a trend break.
theses.dissent: A mean-reversion in defensive sectors or a risk-on shift could cause underperformance, especially if rate expectations shift.

falsifier.text: Utilities loses trend-gate eligibility (eligibility flips to false) within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals has extremely narrow breadth (0.111) and low durability (0.47), making momentum concentrated and fragile. Even though it passes the trend gate, the risk-reward is unattractive due to concentration risk.
theses.dissent: Strong copper demand from electrification and AI capex could lift the entire theme, overcoming narrow breadth.

falsifier.text: Base Metals breadth rises above 0.5 and durability climbs above 0.6 within 20 trading days, signalling broadening participation.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
